name: General Legal
description:
General Legal is a law firm that combines world-class attorneys with AI-native execution. With the General Legal connector, you can kick off new legal projects right from the conversations and workflows you're already in--leveraging the same elite counsel in a new, seamless package.  Open matters, ask questions, respond to your attorney's comments, and download the redlined document, all through Claude.

What you can do: start a matter from a question or a document · upload .docx/.pdf contracts via a secure one-time link (file contents never pass through the model) · track review status across your matters · message your attorney in the matter thread · download reviewed, released versions.

Requires a General Legal account. Your documents are only visible to your own organization.

_published_faq.name: How do I add General Legal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add General Legal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.general.legal/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the General Legal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: General Legal provides these MCP tools: confirm_upload, download_contract, list_contracts, list_deals, list_thread_messages, reply_to_thread, start_deal, and upload_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to General Legal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to General Legal in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does General Legal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: General Legal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
General Legal is developed by General Legal. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
